summary: Commit fea7a17 cleanly generalizes RAG seeding from a single WHITEPAPER.md to recursive docs/**/*.md ingestion. Diff is well-scoped: only mcp/Cargo.toml (walkdir = "2"), Cargo.lock, and mcp/src/seed.rs change. core/ is not touched, no payment methods moved, no HashEmbedder introduced -- architectural rules from CLAUDE.md are preserved. Renames (parse_whitepaper -> parse_markdown, find_whitepaper -> find_docs_root) are consistently propagated through 7 unit tests. New helpers (walk_docs_tree, rel_path_string) are pure, deterministic (sorted by relpath), and well-tested (walks_docs_tree_finds_markdown_files exercises hidden/historical/.pdf skip rules and sort order). Per-chunk content is prefixed with `# <relpath>` and tags become ["protocol-knowledge", "<relpath>"], giving the LLM provenance and disambiguating duplicate headings across docs. Idempotency guard unchanged. Empty-corpus and zero-chunk edge cases both log warn + return Ok. Verified chat.rs consumer: it does NOT filter by tag at all -- chat_handler calls tools::recall, which delegates to SqliteStore::search (cosine over embeddings, signer-scoped, no tag predicate), so dropping the "whitepaper" tag is a no-op for the chat path. Build/lint/test all green. Approved with two nits below for follow-up polish.

findings.issue: Stale doc comment on `Section`: '/// Section extracted from the whitepaper markdown.' still says 'whitepaper' although the parser is now document-agnostic.
findings.suggestion: Update to '/// Section extracted from a markdown document.' for consistency with the renamed parse_markdown.

findings.issue: walk_docs_tree silently skips hidden / historical components but does not emit a tracing::debug for what was skipped, making it harder to diagnose 'why is doc X not in chat?' in prod.
findings.suggestion: Optional: add a `tracing::debug!("seed: skipping {}", rel.display())` inside the skip branch. Non-blocking; current behavior is acceptable since the test asserts the skip set explicitly.

findings.issue: Comment '// RAG seeding (whitepaper chunking + artifact generation)' is now stale; corpus is no longer just whitepaper.
findings.suggestion: Change to 'RAG seeding (docs/**/*.md chunking + artifact generation)'.

verification.walkdir_version: walkdir = "2" (caret implied; allows patch+minor updates within 2.x).
verification.cargo_clippy_mcp: pass with -D warnings (cached: 'Finished dev profile' only)
verification.cargo_test_seed: 15 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored (incl. new walks_docs_tree_finds_markdown_files and parse_markdown_disambiguates_via_path)
verification.chat_consumer_check: mcp/src/chat.rs has zero references to 'whitepaper'. chat_handler -> tools::recall -> SqliteStore::search uses cosine similarity scoped by signer pubkey only (no tag filter). Dropping the 'whitepaper' tag is safe; no regression.
verification.architectural_rules: core/ not modified. Payment methods unchanged in mcp/src/payment.rs. No HashEmbedder anywhere. Dependency direction core <- mcp preserved (mnemonic_core::identity / storage / tools imports only).
verification.idempotency: Unchanged: skip branch on `count_by_signer(pubkey) > 0` still gates the whole run.
